cohort: A total of 5753 mothers were included from national representative mini EDHS 2019 data in Ethiopia.
finding: The proportion of cesarean sections clustered geographically in Ethiopia, with hotspot areas in Addis Ababa, Oromia, Tigray, Derie Dewa, Amhara, and SNNR regions, and was significantly associated with various maternal socioeconomic and demographic factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section, as a mode of birth, was significantly associated with mothers' age, education level, Muslim religion, wealth index, parity, and multiple pregnancies.
